messages:
Mia (Support): Hey @Sam — following up on your ticket about missing audit logs and the failed retention export from your private deployment. Can you confirm this is the VPC private stack (redwood-private-nyc) and whether you saw any KMS errors in your app logs?
Sam - Aurora Health: yep redwood-private-nyc. Export job failed yesterday evening. UI shows 500 when requesting /exports/audit-log. No logs in the audit console for the window 03/10 20:00-22:00. We also saw auth errors in our app: \`kms:Decrypt AccessDenied\`.
Mia (Support): thanks. grabbing our infra logs now. routing to infra eng to check KMS/HSM path. assigning to Ryan.
Ryan (Infra Eng): @Mia looking. I can see a key rotation event for customer-managed key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-efgh that completed 2026-03-10T19:58:12Z. Some of the private nodes show decryption errors when fetching archived KV blobs. Error sample from node-12: ```2026-03-10T20:01:03Z ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/private-node-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:...```.
Sam - Aurora Health: that matches what we saw. So rotation triggered and now export job can't read old encrypted blobs? This is a HIPAA issue for us — need proof of log retention and we have a BAA.
Lee (Security): @Sam apologies. We'll treat as an escalation. Two tracks: immediate workaround to complete your export, and post-mortem + evidence for BAA compliance (audit timeline, KMS/HSM attestation, rotation logs). Mia/Kelsey, can you get a compliance packet prep?
Kelsey (Customer Success): on it. I'll pull the retention policy, timestamped audit trail, and HSM attestation certs. ETA 2 business days. Do you need the rotation key policy?
Sam - Aurora Health: yes please. Also we saw an unexpected billing spike tied to repeated export retries — can you suppress charges while this is unresolved?
Mia (Support): I'll open a billing hold request and flag it to finance. @audit-bot please attach export attempt counts for 03/10 19:30-21:30 for customer aurora-health-project-12.
audit-bot: Attached: export_attempts=18, successful=0, errors=18, avg_response_ms=1102.
Ryan (Infra Eng): Temporary mitigation: we can create a one-time fallback decryption path by re-keying the affected blobs with the current key (requires customer consent). Command we use internally: ```# internal rewrap helper
rewrap --project aurora-health-project-12 --key current-kms-key --objects /archive/2026-03-10/*
```This will allow the export to succeed. It requires a short maintenance window (~15min) and will be logged.
Sam - Aurora Health: we need written approval and evidence this preserves integrity. Also prefer a solution that doesn't require us to send PHI offsite.
Lee (Security): understood. Rewrap happens in-customer VPC and doesn't transfer plaintext out of the cluster. I'll prepare a short technical note + HSM attestation excerpt confirming key material never leaves HSM.
Ryan (Infra Eng): Scheduling rewrap now for 2026-03-11T02:00Z. Will capture logs and provide a signed hash of exported file for verification.
Sam - Aurora Health: ok please pause until we sign the consent form.
Kelsey (Customer Success): Consent form sent to Sam via secure share. Also included draft language about billing credit for the failed export retries.
Sam - Aurora Health: signed and returned. Thanks.
security-oncall (PD): FYI — I'm following. Also recommend we check our KMS rotation automation to ensure roles/policies get updated in all private nodes post-rotation.
Ryan (Infra Eng): noted. Initial root cause: rotation automation didn't propagate a policy attachment to private-node-role in one AZ. Following: fix in flight to make policy apply via instance identity at boot to avoid future drift.
Mia (Support): Next steps: 1) run rewrap at scheduled slot (consent received) 2) complete export and provide signed sha256 of exported archive 3) billing hold + credit confirmation 4) compliance packet (HSM attestation, rotation logs, audit trail) from Kelsey/Lee. We'll update this thread when each step is done. :lock: :white_check_mark:
Sam - Aurora Health: appreciated. can you also include timestamped evidence of when rotation occurred and a copy of the rotation workflow? Our legal team will want it for the HIPAA/BAA addendum breach review.
Kelsey (Customer Success): copy of rotation workflow attached in secure share, rotation timestamp log included. I'll send the compliance packet once rewrap/export done.
Ryan (Infra Eng): rewrap completed at 2026-03-11T02:03:21Z. Export started and completed at 2026-03-11T02:17:09Z. Export SHA256: ```3f786850e387550fdab836ed7e6dc881de23001b```
Mia (Support): export SHA received, signed by infra key. Billing hold applied — finance notified to review credits. Compliance packet draft sent to Sam.
Sam - Aurora Health: received the files. We'll review and get back if legal needs more. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Lee (Security): We'll open a post-mortem and include remediation: tighten rotation automation, alert on KMS Decrypt spikes, and automated policy diff post-rotation. ETA for PM: 3 business days.
Mia (Support): closing loop here but will keep thread open until Sam confirms legal sign-off. :eyes:
Sam - Aurora Health: closing from our side after legal sign-off. thanks everyone.)
